title: Hazel and the Garden
author: Theo Eriksen
blurb: Hazel Delacroix, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
